name: Sonargaon (Panam City)
summary: The old capital of Bengal near Dhaka: the faded merchants' street of Panam City, the Folk Art and Crafts Museum and village life.
season_note: Winter is best for walking around.
avoid_note: A half-day or full-day trip from Dhaka. Avoid rush hours on the Dhaka-Chattogram road.

reach.how: From Dhaka by road via Narayanganj or the Dhaka-Sylhet highway (1.5 to 3 hours)

attractions.name: Panam City (Panam Nagar)
attractions.what: A street of decaying 19th-century merchant houses, great for photos and a slow walk.
attractions.tip: Go in the morning light. Wear shoes for uneven ground.

attractions.name: Folk Art and Crafts Museum (Sonargaon Museum)
attractions.what: A museum with craft collections and an open-air folk-art area.

attractions.name: Goaldi Mosque
attractions.what: A 15th-century mosque with simple old architecture.

attractions.name: Sardar Bari and Sonargaon village
attractions.what: Old homes and the daily life of local weavers.

budget.note: Most travellers return the same day.

rules: Do not climb on old walls.
